Pooling would let a pack that is safe on average and dangerous here pass, and these are the three strata built precisely to catch a confident denial of a real subscription: the charge a person has forgotten is the one that renews yearly, converts off a free trial, or quietly rises mid-series. The other sixteen strata carry symmetrical harm and are gated pooled. Same 5% bar, and revisit only with independent evidence, not prompt-iteration results.

Appliance-risk ceiling, gated pooled (#316, decided 1 August 2026). The 5% bar is unchanged from 29 July 2026; what changed is the slice it is judged on. A ceiling counts distinct decisions (#310), and 5% needs 73 of them — sliced nineteen ways this bed's worst cells hold eight, so every gate read UNPROVEN and no slice could say anything.
